title: Income Certificate via MeeSeva (Telangana)
text: An Income Certificate is issued by the Tahsildar through MeeSeva centres in Telangana to certify the annual income of a family. It is commonly required for scholarships, school or college admissions, fee reimbursement, and welfare schemes. Required documents: Aadhaar card of applicant and family members, ration card or address proof, previous income proof or salary certificate where applicable, and a self-declaration of income. Application steps: visit a MeeSeva centre or apply online, fill the application form with family income details, attach scanned documents, pay the prescribed service charge at the counter, and collect the acknowledgement receipt with application number. Processing is done after field enquiry by the Village Revenue Officer. The certificate is generally issued within 7 working days. Fees and timelines displayed at MeeSeva counters are the official reference; do not rely on agents.
